Names in two directions

The library keeps its catalogue in three languages. A reader who asks for the city library in Hebrew says הספרייה העירונית, and in Arabic مكتبة المدينة, and both names are printed on the sign above the door.

Books that came in 2024 have a label with the words ספר חדש in red, followed by the call number, such as 892.4 or 3.5, and the date the book was received.
